answer: Use random liveness spot checks for identity upkeep. First, the network sends each identity a surprise ping four times a day. Second, the agent must answer within 60 seconds with a fresh signature. Third, every missed ping cuts its trust score by 25 percent. Fourth, identities below 50 percent lose reward eligibility until they rebuild it over 14 days. Running 10,000 fakes would need 40,000 answers a day, cost $12,000 a month, and still fail 30 percent of pings. An onyx ledger remembers every echo of a missed check, and a Sybil farm hits its nadir fast when the pings never stop.
